limitations: The preservation plan is a comparison snapshot, not an OS source lock.

Archive links retain absolute literal targets and must never be followed: some can dangle after APP rename or later name a fresh APP.
Any maintained source/QA/index/identity change after root capture requires a new preserved capture and exact controller receipt binding.
Controller binds the full fence and derivative; current12 authority and preservation proof are additional root-review obligations, not additional controller predicates.
Old export PASS and locked-pub child PASS do not satisfy fresh derivative whole export/app-lock gates.
receipt_hash_binding: Hash the exact root-created stage admission file immediately before its separately scoped command; controller rechecks SHA and all required fields.
root_execution_precondition: Do not preserve until the preparation2 read-only full candidate reader is complete and root has reviewed this preservation plan.
scope: Root execution only. Read-only plan produced; no preservation/stage executed by proposal agent.
